$description: Rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each rule id here is implemented under the SAME id in schema/semantic_validate.py; verify_all.py checks the two id sets are identical.

rules.rule: nodes must match the declared template's node list in order (required / optional / repeatable), keyed on (section, variant).
PageSpec theme must equal the template theme (mars | legacy-black).
mars pages use chrome.navbar + chrome.footer and only mars sections; legacy pages use chrome.legacy-nav, no footer, only legacy sections. The two chromes never mix.
a (section, variant) whose template node is not repeatable may appear once; content.title-row and layout.spacer are repeatable.
at most one node whose (section, variant) is in heroKeys. case.studies-title/compact is a title band, not a hero (case-study-detail has both).
if a hero exists it is the first node after the nav, ignoring layout.spacer/divider-30.
two layout.spacer nodes may never be adjacent.
the node right after chrome.navbar is never a band-65 spacer (only divider-30, divider-30-tablet-up or top-64).
conversion.two-products-band is immediately followed by chrome.footer.
a band spacer directly before chrome.footer doubles the footer's own 67px band.
template home and section hero.home only on route '/'.
route is an internal path and is not an existing redirect source in templates/routes.json.
every string with a maxWords budget in its section contract is within budget (computed per instance).
long-form sections carry contentPolicy summary-only, summaries <= 2 sentences, total outline words <= 600, no forbidden prose keys.
every form endpointPolicy == must-not-reuse-live-endpoint; no string anywhere may reference a HubSpot endpoint.

every link field is internal-route, in-page-anchor, mailto, or https on an allowed outbound host (policies/link-kinds.json); null only on known dead-button fields. In mode=generation absolute URLs are judged by GENERATION_MODE_URL instead (placeholder .example/.invalid hosts only).

clone mode: refs other than an existing /assets/ file only for roles whose cloneModePolicy is may-generate-new or operator-supplied. generation mode: asset.user-supplied needs a user-supplied:<id> ref (role availability itself is judged by the GENERATION_MODE_* rules).
every node's motion carries the section's reducedMotionFallback (also schema-enforced).
node ids are unique within a PageSpec.
at most one node per page uses a hero text appear (hero-word-blur-in / text-effect).

Registry integrity, checked on every validation: assets/asset-roles.json availability/generationModePolicy must equal PINNED_AVAILABILITY and every section's retrievalEligible must equal the RETRIEVAL_INELIGIBLE pin (both pins live in this validator AND extraction/verify_all.py). Editing a registry alone cannot loosen generation safety.
node.tokens.* and content x-tokenField values must name a token in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json.
No raw hex / rgb() / hsl() colour in a token slot or in any non-link content string; reference semantic token names.
node.tokens.spacingY must be one of token-policy slots.node.tokens.spacingY.allowed; px/rem/bare numbers are rejected.
node.tokens.font must be a typography.fontFamily token used by the template's chrome family.
A semantic token must exist in the PageSpec's theme (mars vs legacy-black) and match its slot prefix (surface./text./border.).

mode=generation: no GlassFlow brand, product names (Tares, Rius), legal entity/address, brand e-mail, wordmark or mark-bearing asset (policies/source-identity.json brand; roles brand.glassflow-mark, brand.dither-mark).
mode=generation: no real person (team, investors, testimonial and post authors) by name or photo (source-identity persons; role person.real-photo).
mode=generation: no real customer/backer company names or logos (source-identity customers; role logo.customer).
mode=generation: no third-party company marks: logo-strip/vendor names and investor firms (source-identity thirdPartyMarks; role logo.third-party).
mode=generation: no GlassFlow product screenshots or mocked product UI (role product.screenshot); use screenshot.placeholder.
mode=generation: no source asset file (/assets/... or an opaque source file id) and no clone-only role; refs must be generate:/placeholder:/user-supplied: on a generation-safe role.
mode=generation: every absolute URL, bare domain or e-mail host must be a reserved placeholder (.example / .invalid); source hosts and paths are named in the message.
mode=generation: embeds (x-embedField, e.g. the calendar) must use a placeholder host; the source cal.com founder embed is rejected anywhere.
mode=generation: no source-specific numeric product claims (number+unit+next-word fingerprints and >=3-digit prices derived from src/).
mode=generation: no 5-word shingle of source copy (hashed, normalised) in authored strings; schema-fixed strings (const/enum/pattern) are exempt.

recommendedAdjacency.layout.spacer: between almost every pair of mars content sections (see templates)
